title: Ship-multibeam roughness analysis, predictors and blind-test scoring code for co-located ship and AUV bathymetry (GRL revision of 2026GL125574)
description: Analysis code for the paper "Ship Multibeam Roughness Ranks Unresolved Seafloor Relief at Unseen Sites: A Pre-Registered Blind Test" (Geophysical Research Letters, 2026GL125574, in revision). From the co-located ship and AUV bathymetry corpus (companion data record 10.5281/zenodo.23515276) it builds the per-tile targets (the band-passed fine-scale relief A_fine and its interior variant), the ship-only roughness feature s_lr and the tile tables; evaluates the within-site Spearman ranking (eval_v1.1) with block bootstrap; trains the gradient-boosted predictor GBT_ship and the CNN predictors V1, V2 and the pretrained P-V1 (pretraining on a ship-only corpus); and runs the two pre-registered blind tests (Phase 4 and Phase 5) from frozen inputs, with the pre-registrations, sign-offs, committed blind calls, deviation notes and scoring outputs. Every reported number traces to a tagged freeze and a cited acquisition record. The submitted rectified-flow super-resolution model with its heteroscedastic sigma product and the synthetic-LR training regime are kept in the repository for the record but do not support the revised paper. Acquisition and harmonization code is the companion record 10.5281/zenodo.21300925. Python 3.12, PyTorch; CNN training on GPU, everything else on CPU.
